tests.title: Ultra Low Emission Zone — Mock Test 1

questions.question: ULEZ in London operates:
options: 24 hours a day, every day except Christmas Day

questions.question: Most petrol cars meeting which Euro standard are ULEZ-compliant?
questions.explanation: Petrol cars are usually compliant if Euro 4 or newer.

questions.question: Most diesel cars meeting which Euro standard are ULEZ-compliant?
questions.explanation: Diesel cars must usually meet Euro 6 to be compliant.

questions.question: If your vehicle does not meet ULEZ standards, you must:
options: Pay the daily ULEZ charge to drive in the zone
questions.explanation: A daily charge applies to non-compliant vehicles.

questions.question: ULEZ now covers:
questions.explanation: ULEZ was expanded across all London boroughs in August 2023.

questions.question: ULEZ aims to improve:
questions.explanation: It is primarily an air-quality measure.

questions.question: You can check if your vehicle meets ULEZ standards using:
questions.explanation: TfL provides a free online vehicle compliance checker.
